card.name: Inside coordinates and number strings
card.fires_on: Digits and separators in the middle of a numeric string, mostly latitude/longitude in degrees, minutes and seconds. It also fires on the digit or colon inside times and table values.

modes.label: Coordinates
modes.description: The space, degree mark or minute mark inside degree-minute-second positions.

modes.label: Digits in tables or times
modes.description: A digit or colon partway through a number in a table, time or statistic.

card.writes: It suppresses number words like hundred, dozen and fifty, so it steers away from spelling out a quantity while the model is inside a numeral.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a written number, especially map coordinates, where the next piece is more digits and not a number word.
